name: Rubik's Cube Stitch Cuber
description: Say “Aloha” to your next favorite collectible — the Rubik’s Cube Stitch Cuber! Inspired by Disney’s Lilo & Stitch, this playful twist on the classic 3×3 Rubik’s Cube lets you show off your fandom while putting your solving skills to the test.
features: Disney Design: Features Stitch’s adorable blue alien design straight from Lilo & Stitch.
Solve & Display: Attach Stitch’s head and ears to create a display-worthy collectible.
Classic Rubik’s Challenge: Twist, turn, and align all six sides like the iconic 3×3 puzzle.
Collect Them All: Part of the Rubik’s Cuber Collection, featuring fan-favorite characters from Disney, Marvel, DC, and more.
Perfect Gift Idea: A must-have for Disney fans, Stitch lovers, and puzzle collectors of all ages.
